translations.web: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.
translations.bsb: Terrors are turned loose against me; they drive away my dignity as by the wind, and my prosperity has passed like a cloud.
translations.kjv: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.
translations.asv: Terrors are turned upon me; They chase mine honor as the wind; And my welfare is passed away as a cloud.
